text: 2026年9月16日，印度商工部发布公告，对原产于或进口自中国的铜缆作出反倾销肯定性终裁，建议征收为期5年的反倾销税，具体如下：生产商上海电气集团腾恩驰科技(苏州)有限公司、金华冠洋电子科技有限公司、浙江超联电子有限公司、宁波卓新通信接插件有限公司均为0美元/吨，中国其他生产商为86美元/吨。涉案产品为所有结构化铜缆，包括超五类、六类、超六类、七类、超七类网线以及跳线。本案涉及印度海关编码854449项下的产品。（中国贸易救济信息网）
text_en: On September 16, 2026, India's Ministry of Commerce and Industry issued an announcement making a positive final anti-dumping determination on copper cables originating in or imported from China, and recommended imposing anti-dumping duties for a period of 5 years, as follows: producers Shanghai Electric Group Tengenchi Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd., Jinhua Guanyang Electronic Technology Co., Ltd., Zhejiang Chaolian Electronic Co., Ltd., and Ningbo Zhuoxin Communication Connector Co., Ltd. are all at $0/ton, while other Chinese producers are at $86/ton. The products involved are all structured copper cables, including Cat5e, Cat6, Cat6a, Cat7, Cat7a network cables, and patch cords. This case involves products under Indian customs code 854449. (China Trade Remedy Information Network)
